_comment: Third-party Qwiic / Stemma QT board registry (DEV-251), next to modules.json. One home per fact: what a supported third-party board IS (addresses, how the brain recognises it, bus load, what it measures). Product manifests only name the type (modules_required with "thirdparty": true). The brain library noknok_thirdparty (brain-Pico, DEV-248) carries the same facts in code; a CI check keeps both in sync. Boards are plugged in with the brain off; there are no reserved addresses (the boot-time scan allocates noknok modules around them). load_ohms = load on the bus when the line is LOW (boards with a level shifter count both resistor pairs). See authoring-products.md, "Third-party boards".
